gaps.sentence: ___ I known about the deadline, I would have hurried.
gaps.explanation: Had I known = If I had known — inversion replaces 'if'.

gaps.sentence: Only by practising daily ___ you improve your fluency.
gaps.explanation: Only by doing X will you… — future inversion after only by.

gaps.sentence: ___ you stands the man responsible for the discovery.
gaps.explanation: Dramatic inversion: 'Before you stands the man…' — the phrase of place is fronted and the verb precedes the subject.

gaps.sentence: Hardly ___ anyone noticed the subtle change in the final scene.
Barely ___ the ink dried when the complaints began to arrive.
gaps.explanation: 'Barely had the ink dried when …' — inverted past perfect.

gaps.sentence: Hardly had we started ___ the engine failed.
gaps.explanation: Hardly … when — fixed pair: Hardly had we started when…

gaps.sentence: Not once ___ she mentioned the incident to anyone.
gaps.explanation: 'Not once has she mentioned' — inversion with the perfect.

gaps.sentence: ___ it not been for the lifeguard, the boy would have drowned.
gaps.explanation: 'Had it not been for …' = 'If it had not been for …'.
